stories.title: NFL preseason Week 1 takeaways: Mendoza debuts for Raiders; Allar shines for Steelers
stories.summary: The NFL preseason is underway! How did rookies and players in new places perform in their debuts?

stories.title: Pickett not budging on No. 5 amid Daniels-LSU flap
stories.summary: LSU's DJ Pickett says he has no plans to change out of the No. 5 amid pushback from Jayden Daniels, with the Commanders' quarterback saying the situation won't be a distraction.

stories.title: Sources: Arnold picks Seahawks amid legal issues
stories.summary: Terrion Arnold, who sources told NFL Network plans to sign a one-year deal with the Seahawks, also had visited the Texans, Saints and Giants before choosing the Seahawks.

stories.title: Dodgers to stick with Diaz despite latest meltdown
stories.summary: Dodgers closer Edwin Diaz blew his third save in his past four chances Thursday night, but manager Dave Roberts said he'd stick with him as closer, lamenting that the team lacks better options.

stories.title: Bertman, 5-time MCWS winner at LSU, dies at 88
stories.summary: Legendary LSU baseball coach Skip Bertman, who transformed the Tigers into a national powerhouse with five Men's College World Series titles, has died at the age of 88.
